tiers.name: Exhibition
tiers.label: Bracket 1: Exhibition
tiers.summary: Prioritize theme, unusual ideas, flexible legality, and showcase gameplay over optimization.
tiers.turnsExpectation: Expect to play at least nine turns before you win or lose.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.label: Bracket 2: Core
tiers.summary: Unoptimized and straightforward decks with incremental, disruptable wins and low-pressure gameplay.
tiers.turnsExpectation: Expect to play at least eight turns before you win or lose.

tiers.name: Upgraded
tiers.label: Bracket 3: Upgraded
tiers.summary: Strong synergy, high card quality, meaningful interaction, and explosive but earned wins.
tiers.turnsExpectation: Expect to play at least six turns before you win or lose.

tiers.name: Optimized
tiers.label: Bracket 4: Optimized
tiers.summary: Fast, lethal, efficient decks with strong game changers, fast mana, tutors, and explosive play.
tiers.turnsExpectation: Expect to play at least four turns before you win or lose.

tiers.name: cEDH
tiers.label: Bracket 5: cEDH
tiers.summary: Metagame-tuned competitive Commander decks built for maximum efficiency and consistency.
tiers.turnsExpectation: Games can end on any turn.
